page: Google Cloud Platform a3-highgpu-4g is an accelerator-optimized instance configured with 4 NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs supplying 320 GB of combined VRAM. Host processing is delivered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor featuring 52 physical cores and 104 vCPUs running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system integrates 936 GB of system RAM, providing approximately 9.0 GB per physical core, alongside 3216 GB of local NVMe SSD storage for rapid scratch data operations.

Benchmark results demonstrate top-tier multi-threaded processing, evidenced by a PassMark CPU score of 86938.94 and a stress-ng multi-core output of 83724.03. The underlying processor supports specialized instruction sets including Intel AMX-tile, AMX-int8, and AVX-512 extensions, which correspond to top-tier PassMark encryption performance of 84930.30 and an extended instructions score of 95800.31. Memory throughput remains solid under load, delivering 216.58 GB/sec on large un-cached block reads and 95.09 GB/sec on large block writes.

In operational data processing, the configuration achieves 90.38 million operations per second in Redis SET testing and 78.48 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. For artificial intelligence tasks, the platform records text generation rates of 38.11 tokens per second on 7B parameter models and 4.61 tokens per second on 70B parameter models. Qualitative cost efficiency reflects an enterprise-grade accelerator profile where the consolidation of four H100 GPUs, expansive host memory, and direct NVMe storage balances execution duration for large-scale model training, inference pipelines, and scientific simulations.
description: Google Cloud Platform a3-highgpu-4g is an accelerator-optimized virtual machine tailored for deep learning and high-performance computing workloads. The server features four NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs with a combined 320 GB of VRAM, paired with a 52-core, 104-vCPU Intel Xeon 8481C processor running at 2.7 GHz. The system includes 936 GB of RAM and 3216 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Benchmark data reflects top-tier multi-threaded compute capability, scoring 86938.94 in PassMark CPU tests and 83724.03 in stress-ng multi-core testing, supported by advanced vector and matrix acceleration via AMX and AVX-512 extensions. Memory bandwidth reaches 216.58 GB/sec on uncached reads, while Redis throughput exceeds 90 million operations per second. Evaluated inference rates achieve 38.11 tokens per second on 7B parameter models. This configuration is built for distributed machine learning training, large language model inference pipelines, and compute-intensive scientific analytics.
